Oct 23, 2026

OpenAI is closing in on a new funding round of up to $30 billion but has lowered its valuation target to get there. The company originally pitched investors on a $1.4 trillion valuation, according to internal documents obtained by the Financial Times. That number has since dropped to $1.25 trillion, CNBC also reports. The FT says demand was weaker than in previous rounds, with some backers experiencing "indigestion" after heavy investments in earlier fundraises.

UAE investors and investment firm Coatue are leading the $30 billion round. The funding is being positioned as a bridge ahead of a potential IPO. OpenAI is also negotiating a commercial deal to secure additional compute capacity through the UAE, according to CNBC.

OpenAI confidentially filed an IPO prospectus with the SEC in June. CFO Sarah Friar told employees in August that OpenAI would be a publicly traded company by 2027. CEO Sam Altman said in September that the timing was unfavorable for going public. He had already communicated that internally back in June. Competitor Anthropic is also preparing an IPO and is targeting a valuation between $1.5 and $2 trillion.

translation.html:
2026年10月23日

OpenAI 即将完成新一轮最高达300亿美元的融资，但为此下调了目标估值。 据《金融时报》获得的内部文件显示，该公司最初向投资者提出的估值为1.4万亿美元。此后，这一数字已降至1.25万亿美元，CNBC 也报道了这一消息。《金融时报》称，投资需求弱于前几轮，一些投资方在此前几轮融资中投入巨资后出现了“消化不良” 。

阿联酋投资者和投资公司 Coatue 正在领投这轮300亿美元的融资。这笔融资被定位为潜在 IPO 之前的过桥融资。据 CNBC 报道，OpenAI 还在洽谈一项商业协议，以通过阿联酋获得更多算力。

OpenAI 于6月秘密向美国证券交易委员会（SEC）提交了 IPO 招股说明书。首席财务官 Sarah Friar 在8月告诉员工，OpenAI 将在2027年之前成为一家上市公司。首席执行官 Sam Altman 在9月表示，当时的时机不适合上市。早在6月，他就已在内部传达了这一看法。竞争对手 Anthropic 也在筹备 IPO，目标估值为1.5万亿至2万亿美元。
